description: Litigation, government investigations, antitrust and regulatory matters: every legal or regulatory section, subsection or passage in the 10-K/10-Q narrative (Item 3 and the contingencies note, as condensed), followed by any legal or regulatory items in the 8-K events digest. Each passage says where in the document it came from. Returns the section's full text as markdown. Headings differ by company and carry the fiscal period, so the section is found by pattern; if this company's narrative has none, the response says so and lists its sections. Pass `record` for the narrative as of an earlier record.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.
